title: Archived image generation tool request
description: Format of request.yaml saved by astrbot_plugin_openai_image_generation. Each numbered request directory is created when the tool accepts the request, with zero-based WebP image files added after successful generation. Interpret the request using the recorded plugin version; this schema describes the current tool contract.

plugin_version.description: Plugin version read from the version field of metadata.yaml when this request was made.

prompt.description: Full generation prompt and optional reference indices for the original chat message. Reference image bytes are not archived; indices alone cannot reconstruct attachments.

images.description: One-based reference image indices from the instructions tool. Omit for text-only generation.

description.description: Image API only: short description sent with the generated images. Responses API uses the returned assistant text instead.

llm.description: Optional Responses API LLM override. Choose astra, sol, terra or luna. Omitted or null uses the configured default.

previous_response_id.description: Responses API only: response_id from a successful earlier request archive to continue editing its images. Use the response ID, not an image call ID or local request number. Omitted or null starts an independent request.

model.description: Image model alias for either API. Omitted or null selects sunburst; the plugin maps the alias to gpt-image-2.6-{alias}.

size.description: Image size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1536x1024. Both dimensions must be multiples of 16 between 16 and 3840. Aspect ratio must be between 1:3 and 3:1, with 655360 to 8294400 total pixels. Omit for automatic sizing.

quality.description: Image quality. Omitted or null selects auto.

complexity.description: Planning complexity. Omitted or null selects high.

background_transparency.description: Background transparency. Omitted or null selects auto.

number_of_images.description: Requested number of images, from 1 to 5. Omitted or null selects 1. Returned files are numbered from 0.webp within this request directory.

request.description: The original JSON arguments supplied by the LLM to openai_image_generate_webp, before defaults, prompt trimming, model name expansion or API payload construction. Omitted fields remain omitted and explicit null values are preserved. This is not the upstream OpenAI HTTP request body.

user_id.description: Original message sender ID obtained automatically from AstrBot event.get_sender_id(), never supplied by the model. Absent in older archives or direct API calls without an event.

response_id.description: Responses API response ID returned after successful image generation. Pass it as request.previous_response_id on a later request to continue this image conversation. Absent in older archives and when the provider does not return a usable ID.

api.description: API selected by the user configuration. Absent in older archives, which used the Image API.
